description: Use this when the user asks where an app sits in the App Store top charts, or why it moved. App Store category chart positions for one app, per storefront: for each chart Apptiller reads (top free or top paid, and top grossing, in the app's category) the place on the latest day read (null: not in the list), that day, the best place of the last 30 days, the place a week before, and the rivals from its search terms that are in the same list. moves lists the app's moves of 5 places or more over the 30 days (into or out of the list too), newest first, each with what Apptiller saw happen that day or the day before (a listing edit, a release, an App Store draft created, a reply posted, a page published, a listing gained). Charts are read daily on a plan. Read-only: it reads no chart itself.
name: app_store_charts
title: App Store category chart positions
